problems: Blocker (root config, R5): the task's verify command `pnpm exec vitest run --project ui` fails for 47 of 57 ui test files, because the root vitest.config.ts has no vite-plugin-solid for the ui project. With ui/vitest.config.ts all 408 tests pass.

Bug in the foundation's Menu primitive (ui/src/primitives/menu/Menu.tsx, not my path): its focus effect can run before its presence-gated rows mount, and on re-open it holds a stale, detached row ref. A Menu that opens after mount therefore does not get keyboard focus: an isolated repro left focus on <body>. I worked around it in MenuBar with a microtask guard (marked TODO(ui-foundation)). Other users of Menu, such as the dock item menu and app menus, may hit the same bug.

Motion contract conflict for the WM compositor: the window keyframes in motion.css (open, minimise, restore, FLIP) animate `transform`, but window-manager.md §3.5 writes window geometry as translate3d on the same element, so the geometry is lost while an animation runs. The gallery writes geometry as left and top. The compositor must put geometry on a wrapper, use left and top, or build the base translate into its WAAPI keyframes.

Genie offset wording: visual-language-macos.md §3.7.1 rule 5 defines --pl-genie-x/y as 'dock-icon centre minus window centre', but the minimise keyframes use transform-origin 50% 100%. The correct input is the dock-icon centre minus the window's bottom centre; with the spec's formula the window lands about half its height below the icon. WindowFrame's prop doc and the gallery use the bottom-centre formula.

Windows have no live blur (DSN-24), so the 94% --pl-glass-window-bg tint let other windows' text visibly ghost through; the light desktop looked messy against the reference. WindowFrame now paints the same tint token twice, for about 99.6% coverage. Please confirm, or add an explicit window-content token (owner R3 or foundation).

Traffic lights are 24 x 24 targets to meet WCAG 2.5.8 (WM spec §3.19), which puts the visible gap between the 12 px circles at 12 px instead of --pl-traffic-gap (8 px). A 20 px spacing fails the 2.5.8 spacing exception.
